items.title: Charter Communications earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Charter Communications (CHTR) posted a -$20.50 EPS for Q3 against a $9.54 estimate. That miss is mostly a $6.3B franchise impairment, a non-cash charge, so it says little about operations. Revenue of $16.51B beat the $13.53B estimate because Cox is now consolidated. The stock fell about 8% pre-market. It then recovered to $122.39 (-2.76%) as of Nov 6, 12:50 PM EST. Shares are still down 41% YTD.
